mentions.name: Gram Jam
mentions.description: A word game featuring puzzles and multiple game modes, built as a PWA with Sentry monitoring and Stripe integration. Recently migrated from Svelte 4 to Svelte 5 to unlock better animation and UX performance, with an onboarding revamp underway and new puzzles and modes planned.
mentions.source_excerpt: Since getting laid off in Feb, I've been spending my free time polishing up my word game Gram Jam (https://gramjam.app).
